body: 把上传白模转成写实室内可视化。严格锁定几何、透视、三座沙发、长方茶几、左侧落地灯、右侧窗户的位置与构图。墙面奶油色灰泥，地面浅橡木，沙发米色亚麻，茶几暖白洞石，灯架黄铜，灯罩白色织物。北欧柔和窗光，不增加家具或装饰，4:3。

instructions.en: Upload the reference images in the listed order. The example uses synthetic input images.
instructions.zh-Hans: 按列出的顺序上传参考图。本例使用合成输入素材。

en.title: Clay model to material visualization
en.description: Sofa, table, lamp and right window retain the clay layout while linen, travertine, oak and brass replace the white materials.
en.body:
## How to use

Copy the exact prompt used for this image. Changing the subject creates a new, untested variant. Upload the ordered synthetic reference images shown in the run before generating.

## Observed result

Sofa, table, lamp and right window retain the clay layout while linen, travertine, oak and brass replace the white materials.

## Source

Independently adapted from the supplied design prompt collection, case 46. [Source](https://github.com/qzh3722/awesome-nano-banana-spatial-design/blob/main/README.md). GPT Image returned no precise version identifier.

zh-Hans.body:
## 使用方法

复制本图实际使用的完整提示词。修改主体后属于尚未验证的新变体。生成前，按顺序上传运行记录中展示的合成参考图。

## 观察结果

沙发、茶几、灯与右窗保持白模布局，新增亚麻、洞石、橡木和黄铜材质。

## 来源
